periodicity.text: The light curve is dominated by a smooth sinusoid with period 0.29144 d (Lomb-Scargle power 0.89); the adopted 1.16592 d is 4.00 x that. The true period is more likely 0.29144 d (pulsation or spots) or 0.58288 d (contact binary), and the 'eclipses' may not be eclipses.
